feats.title: Soldier of Virtue
feats.description: Once per day, you can use the virtue’s touch power. In addition, you can wield paladin implements.

feats.title: Squire of Righteousness
feats.description: You have proficiency with holy symbols. You gain the defender aura power. You can use righteous radiance as an encounter power.

feats.title: Soldier of the Faith
feats.description: Once per encounter, you can use the Paladin’s divine challenge power. In addition, you can use a holy symbol or a holy avenger as an implement.
